t: This Luceco Prysm outdoor LED solar wall light provides efficient and reliable illumination for domestic external areas. It is ideal for lighting pathways, garden spaces, or enhancing security around homes with its automatic lighting function. The unit features a high-quality monocrystalline solar panel, powering both front and rear illumination, including a subtle amber night light for ambient outdoor lighting. Equipped with a PIR motion detection sensor, it offers smart power usage for extended battery life and delivers 600 lumens of cool white 4000K light. Its robust ABS body and IP54 rating ensure durability in outdoor conditions.
